apps.name: Calculator
apps.description: Simple calculator with basic arithmetic operations. Supports keyboard input.

apps.name: mvmAI
apps.description: AI chat assistant with shell access. Talk to any OpenAI-compatible provider (Gemini, OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Ollama, custom). The assistant can run commands on the server on your behalf, with configurable confirmation and safety levels.

apps.name: Cost Splitter
apps.description: Split recurring costs among members. Track balances, add payments, and send monthly email summaries automatically.

apps.name: State Tracker
apps.description: Track state changes of anything over time — ping, HTTP checks, API values, or manual push. Color-coded timeline.

apps.name: Beam Builder
apps.description: 3D construction planner. Draw beams and profiles in 3D space, connect them, rotate and zoom freely, and get a full material list with costs.

apps.name: mvm2factor
apps.description: TOTP two-factor authentication manager. Add accounts with a secret key and get animated 6-digit codes that refresh every 30 seconds.

apps.name: RSS Reader
apps.description: RSS/Atom feed reader with auto-refresh, read/unread tracking, bookmarks, AI summarization via mvmAI, and optional public reading list.

apps.name: QuoteBuilder
apps.description: Project quote builder. Add services with time (hours + minutes) or fixed prices, set an hourly rate, apply discounts and deposit, and share a live public link with your client.

apps.name: QueueDesk
apps.description: Public booking and queue-ticket system. Run a weekly appointment schedule or a walk-in number queue — clients book or pull a ticket from a public page with no account needed, and you get notified and manage everything from here.
